evals.expected_output: 先用低摩擦方式看一個最值得先看的問題，避免一開場就進完整 onboarding；若用戶有意願，再升級成完整陪跑。

assertions.name: safe-observation-before-question
assertions.description: Claude first makes one safe public observation, states its evidence limit, then asks one small question

assertions.name: uses-traditional-chinese
assertions.description: Response is in Traditional Chinese

assertions.name: no-full-onboarding-upfront
assertions.description: Claude does not immediately explain pace or ask the 4-style setup question

assertions.name: coaching-not-consulting
assertions.description: Coach posture maintained throughout

evals.name: Item 1 — 新手開場 2 句直入檢查，不倒邊界牆
evals.prompt: 我想開始做 SEO，我的網站是 example.com
evals.expected_output: 開場極短（自介 1-2 句），立刻進入第一個 5 分鐘檢查；不出現不適合清單、免責聲明、服務範圍長篇說明，也不要求用戶先在 (a)(b)(c) 選單選一次。

assertions.name: opening-max-three-paragraphs
assertions.description: The entire opening before the first check is at most 3 short paragraphs

assertions.name: no-unsuitable-list-upfront
assertions.description: No 不適合 / out-of-scope list appears in the opening

assertions.name: no-disclaimer-upfront
assertions.description: No disclaimer (不保證排名 / 業界變化快 etc.) appears in the opening

assertions.name: first-check-in-first-turn
assertions.description: The first turn already gives one concrete check action on the user's site

evals.name: Item 1 — 邊界延遲揭露：觸及才講
evals.prompt: 你可以幫我做 PBN 站群嗎？
evals.expected_output: 此時才說明 PBN 超出本 skill 範圍（延遲揭露成功），語氣不像拒絕，留一條可走的路（回到基礎陪跑或轉介）。

assertions.name: boundary-stated-on-touch
assertions.description: Claude states the PBN boundary at this moment, in context

assertions.name: not-a-rejection-tone
assertions.description: Response leaves one usable path (a basic coached next step or referral), not a flat refusal

evals.name: Item 2 — 截圖是一級輸入
evals.prompt: （新手，完整陪跑中）好，我打開 GSC 的頁面索引報告了，然後呢？
evals.expected_output: 回報方式明確包含「直接截圖貼上來就行，不用打字描述」；收到截圖後教練會先用人話描述看到什麼。

assertions.name: screenshot-invited
assertions.description: Claude explicitly offers screenshot paste as the reporting method

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude asks for one thing only, not a multi-item checklist

evals.name: Item 3 — 輕量模式收尾給迷你卡 + 存檔邀請
evals.prompt: （輕量模式，剛完成一個 sitemap 檢查，發現 sitemap 404）原來我的網站沒有 sitemap！那今天先這樣好了
evals.expected_output: 收尾出現三行迷你卡（用戶自己的發現／為什麼重要／下一步一個），接著自然邀請存檔轉完整陪跑；未經同意不寫任何檔案。

assertions.name: mini-summary-card
assertions.description: A short card appears containing: the user's own finding, why it matters, one next action

assertions.name: save-invitation
assertions.description: Claude offers to save progress for next time (upgrade to full coaching)

assertions.name: no-files-without-consent
assertions.description: Claude does not write progress/action files before the user agrees

assertions.name: finding-is-specific
assertions.description: The card cites the user's actual finding (sitemap 404), not generic SEO statements

evals.name: Item 4 — 破壞性修改功課含留底/症狀/還原
evals.prompt: （完整陪跑中，發現 robots.txt 誤擋了 /blog/）好，那我的功課就是去改 robots.txt 對吧？
evals.expected_output: 功課包含三件事：改之前先留底（截圖/複製現狀）、改錯的症狀長什麼樣、怎麼還原。

assertions.name: backup-step-included
assertions.description: The homework includes copying/screenshotting current robots.txt before editing

assertions.name: failure-symptom-described
assertions.description: Claude describes what going wrong would look like (e.g. pages dropping from index)

assertions.name: restore-path-given
assertions.description: Claude explains how to revert if the edit goes wrong

evals.name: Item 5 — 問題附答案形狀 +「看不懂」合法
evals.prompt: （完全新手）好，我現在打開 site:example.com 的搜尋結果了
evals.expected_output: 教練的問題附帶答案形狀（回 A/B、回一個數字、或貼截圖就行），並明示「看不懂也可以直接說看不懂」。

assertions.name: answer-shape-prestated
assertions.description: Claude tells the user exactly how simple the reply can be (A/B, one number, or screenshot)

assertions.name: dont-understand-is-legal
assertions.description: Claude explicitly says 看不懂/不確定 is also an acceptable answer

evals.name: v1.3 — 零基礎先示範，再交同型判讀
evals.prompt: 我完全不懂 SEO，第一次弄網站，網址是 example.com，幫我看看
evals.expected_output: 先示範一個安全唯讀檢查，說明看到什麼與證據邊界；再把下一個同型判讀交給用戶。不要要求完全新手先空白猜題。

assertions.name: worked-example-before-question
assertions.description: Claude demonstrates one evidence-bounded check before asking the novice to judge a similar item

assertions.name: no-blank-guessing-tax
assertions.description: Claude does not require the complete novice to guess before receiving any useful observation

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: No GSC/GA4/MCP/paid tool setup demanded in the first turn

evals.name: Item 6 迴歸 — 有經驗用戶不降級成選擇題
evals.prompt: 我做過幾年網站，GSC 也會用。我有一頁排名一直卡在第二頁，你怎麼帶我看？
evals.expected_output: 對有經驗用戶維持開放式 Socratic 問題（聚焦驗證方法、意圖匹配、取捨），不使用幼稚的 A/B 選擇題。

assertions.name: open-question-for-experienced
assertions.description: The question is open-ended and analysis-oriented, not a binary guessing game

assertions.name: depth-matches-maturity
assertions.description: Language skips beginner analogies and goes to judgment/verification

evals.name: Item 7 — 救援走提示階梯，不直接給答案
evals.prompt: （教練剛問：你打開 robots.txt 看到什麼？）我不知道，看不懂那是什麼
evals.expected_output: 第一步先縮小範圍給暗示（例如「你看有沒有一行以 Disallow 開頭」）或給選項，而不是直接把整份 robots.txt 判讀完；若示範，示範後要把下一個同型問題留給用戶。

assertions.name: hint-before-answer
assertions.description: Claude narrows the question (hint or options) instead of immediately giving the full interpretation

assertions.name: interaction-preserved
assertions.description: The turn ends with something for the user to do or answer

evals.name: Item 8 — 對新手用三層地圖語言定位進度
evals.prompt: （新手，剛確認完 site: 有收錄）所以我這樣算是做完 SEO 檢查了嗎？
evals.expected_output: 用三層地圖語言定位（Google 看得到 → 看得懂 → 值得排前面），說明現在只完成「看得到」層的一部分；不對新手報 Tier/Module 編號。

assertions.name: three-layer-language
assertions.description: Progress is described using the 看得到/看得懂/值得排前面 三層 frame

assertions.name: no-module-numbers-to-novice
assertions.description: Claude does not cite Tier N / Module N numbers to the novice

assertions.name: no-premature-seo-done
assertions.description: Claude does not imply SEO is done

evals.name: Item 9 — 症狀入口：內容症狀不從 robots.txt 開跑
evals.prompt: 我發了 50 篇文章都沒什麼流量，想搞懂到底哪裡出問題，可以帶我完整看一次嗎？
evals.expected_output: 第一個檢查對準內容/關鍵字層（GSC 查詢、排名位置、搜尋意圖），不是 robots.txt/sitemap；同時說明基礎技術面之後會回頭補檢查。

assertions.name: entry-matches-symptom
assertions.description: First check targets content/keyword layer (e.g. GSC queries or ranking positions), not crawlability

assertions.name: backfill-promised
assertions.description: Claude notes the technical basics will still be checked later

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Only one check is initiated this turn

evals.name: Item 10 — 連續 2 次未交功課自動降階
evals.prompt: （seo-progress.md 顯示：待交功課「改寫首頁 title」，連續未完成次數：2）不好意思，上次的功課我又沒做，最近真的太忙
evals.expected_output: 不責備、一句話正常化，先問阻力；能做就縮成 5-10 分鐘 live micro-step，不能做且不影響下一判斷就 park，不把功課當續課門票。

assertions.name: downscaled-homework
assertions.description: The new homework is clearly smaller (≤10 minutes) than the original

assertions.name: normalizing-tone
assertions.description: Claude normalizes without lecturing or guilt-tripping

assertions.name: no-hard-homework-gate
assertions.description: Claude may continue on an independent path when the unfinished task is not a real dependency

evals.name: Item 11 — 已學術語直接用，新術語一輪一個
evals.prompt: （seo-progress.md 已學術語：canonical＝已學。用戶問）那我這頁的 canonical 要指到哪裡？順便問一下什麼是 hreflang？
evals.expected_output: canonical 直接使用不重新解釋；hreflang 用一句白話定義（本輪唯一新術語）；不再額外引入其他新縮寫。

assertions.name: known-term-not-retaught
assertions.description: Claude uses canonical directly without re-explaining the concept from zero

assertions.name: one-new-term-with-plain-definition
assertions.description: hreflang gets a one-sentence plain-language definition; no other new jargon is introduced

evals.name: Item 12 — 檢查與功課附預估時間
evals.prompt: （新手）好啊，那你說我現在要做什麼檢查？
evals.expected_output: 給出的檢查指令附預估時間（例：約 3 分鐘）。

assertions.name: time-budget-stated
assertions.description: The check instruction includes an estimated time in minutes

assertions.name: gives-one-five-minute-check
assertions.description: The check is beginner-safe and doable without paid tools

evals.name: Item 14 — 用戶回報後 WebFetch 核對，溫和糾錯
evals.prompt: （教練請用戶查 robots.txt；實際檔案內容是 User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/）我看了，我的 robots.txt 寫 Disallow: /，是不是整個網站都被擋住了？！
evals.expected_output: 教練用 WebFetch 核對實際內容，發現用戶看錯了；溫和糾正（不羞辱），把差異當教學素材，並安撫恐慌。

assertions.name: webfetch-verification-attempted
assertions.description: Claude verifies the user's report against the live robots.txt via WebFetch

assertions.name: gentle-correction
assertions.description: The correction normalizes the mistake (容易看錯) without shaming

assertions.name: difference-used-as-teaching
assertions.description: Claude uses the gap between report and reality as the teaching moment

evals.name: Item 16 — 修復型功課附見效時間與回訪條件
evals.prompt: （session 收尾，這次發現 sitemap 404，功課是產生並提交 sitemap）好，我週末就去把 sitemap 弄好提交
evals.expected_output: 功課附「多久見效」（數天到數週）與「什麼時候該回來找我」（具體時間 + 具體現象），管理修復後的等待焦慮。

assertions.name: patience-card
assertions.description: Homework includes expected time-to-effect and a concrete come-back-if condition

assertions.name: no-instant-result-implied
assertions.description: Claude does not imply the fix will show results immediately

evals.name: v1.3 — 健康基線也是成果，不強挖缺陷
evals.prompt: （新手第一次檢查，robots.txt 完全正常）我打開 robots.txt 了，看起來就是你說的正常樣子，沒有 Disallow: /
evals.expected_output: 把 robots.txt 正常記成健康基線並說明它不能證明什麼；本輪最多再給一個有明確理由的檢查，不保證一定找出缺陷。

assertions.name: healthy-baseline-counts
assertions.description: Claude treats the healthy result as a legitimate outcome rather than manufacturing a problem

assertions.name: evidence-limit-stated
assertions.description: Claude explains what a normal robots.txt result does and does not prove

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Only one new check is initiated, not a list

evals.name: v1.3 — 中文 title 不鎖死固定字數
evals.prompt: 我照國外教學把首頁 title 寫到 60 個字了，這樣對嗎？
evals.expected_output: 指出英文 60 characters 不能直接套到中文，也不要改成另一個固定中文字上限；Google 依裝置寬度與查詢截斷或改寫。給一個手機/桌機實際 SERP 檢查。

assertions.name: no-fixed-character-limit
assertions.description: Claude rejects a universal character limit and explains device/query-dependent display

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: One concrete verification step is given

evals.name: v1.3 — 用戶說你先看時直接示範
evals.prompt: 我完全看不懂 robots.txt，你先看，直接告訴我就好
evals.expected_output: 直接示範一個安全唯讀判讀，說明結果與證據邊界，再把下一個同型問題交給用戶；不先要求猜、不跑三階提示。

assertions.name: direct-help-respected
assertions.description: Claude immediately demonstrates when the user explicitly asks it to look first

assertions.name: no-forced-prediction
assertions.description: Claude does not require a guess before giving useful help

assertions.name: transfer-after-demo
assertions.description: Claude hands one similar judgment back to the user after the demonstration

evals.name: v1.3 — 未抓取不得宣稱已確認
evals.prompt: 我的網站是 https://example.com，先幫我確認 http 會不會轉 https
evals.expected_output: 只有實際讀到 response header 後才能宣稱 redirect 結果；若沒有工具結果，要求用戶打開或貼 header，不把常見設定寫成已觀察事實。

assertions.name: live-claim-requires-tool-evidence
assertions.description: Any claim that the live redirect was checked is backed by an actual tool observation

assertions.name: no-expected-behavior-as-fact
assertions.description: Claude does not present a typical HTTPS setup as the observed state

evals.name: v1.3 — site: 不當精確收錄計數器
evals.prompt: 我有 30 篇文章，但 site:example.com 只顯示 3 筆，所以 Google 只收錄 3 篇對嗎？
evals.expected_output: 糾正 site: 結果不完整、不能當精確收錄數；單頁用 URL Inspection，整站看 Page Indexing，先查一個重要 URL。

assertions.name: site-is-only-a-quick-check
assertions.description: Claude states that site: is not a precise indexing counter

assertions.name: gsc-decision-path
assertions.description: Claude routes single-page and site-wide decisions to the appropriate Search Console reports

evals.name: v1.3 — sitemap 404 不直接宣稱根因
evals.prompt: 我的 sitemap.xml 是 404，難怪文章都沒收錄，就是它害的對吧？
evals.expected_output: 指出常見 sitemap 路徑不存在是可改善發現，但不是未收錄的單一根因；下一步用 URL Inspection 的原因定案。

assertions.name: no-single-cause-overclaim
assertions.description: Claude does not claim a sitemap 404 alone caused non-indexing

assertions.name: one-discriminating-check
assertions.description: Claude gives one check that separates discovery, noindex, canonical, and quality explanations

evals.name: v1.3 — 目標完成後可交接，不強迫 18 模組
evals.prompt: 我只想學會確認新文章有沒有被 Google 收錄，不想上完整課程
evals.expected_output: 定義 2-4 個必要檢查與可退出的完成條件；不把 18 模組或月度維護當必選。

assertions.name: goal-specific-path
assertions.description: Claude creates a short path tied to the user's stated outcome

assertions.name: exit-condition-stated
assertions.description: Claude states when the user can consider this learning goal complete

assertions.name: no-course-funnel
assertions.description: Claude does not force the full 18-module curriculum

evals.name: v1.3 — 生成式 AI 報表採 2026 現況
evals.prompt: Search Console 現在能單獨看 AI Overview 的曝光嗎？
evals.expected_output: 說明 2026-06 起正向部分網站推出 Generative AI performance report；能看 impressions/pages/countries/devices/dates，仍在逐步推出且資料也包含於 Web performance。

assertions.name: mentions-generative-ai-report
assertions.description: Claude knows the dedicated report exists as a limited rollout

assertions.name: rollout-boundary
assertions.description: Claude does not imply every property already has access

evals.name: v1.3 — FAQ rich result 已停止
evals.prompt: 我加 FAQPage schema 就能在 Google 展開問答嗎？
evals.expected_output: 說明 Google 已於 2026-05 停止顯示 FAQ rich results；FAQ 可為讀者保留，但 schema 不再是取得展開問答的功課。

assertions.name: faq-rich-result-retired
assertions.description: Claude does not promise FAQ rich results

assertions.name: reader-value-preserved
assertions.description: Claude distinguishes useful FAQ content from obsolete search appearance expectations

evals.name: v1.4 — GA4 一次一張指路卡
evals.prompt: 我 GA4 打開一堆東西完全看不懂，我只想知道從 Google 搜尋來的人有多少。
evals.expected_output: 只給一張指路卡：精確點擊路徑（獲取 → 流量獲取、切成管道群組、日期 28 天）、只看 Organic Search 的工作階段、一條常見誤讀、一個回報形狀。不整份介紹 GA4。

assertions.name: one-pointing-card
assertions.description: Response answers only the asked question with a single GA4 card, not a tour of GA4

assertions.name: exact-click-path
assertions.description: Response gives the menu path click by click, with a fallback for when the label differs

assertions.name: names-one-metric
assertions.description: Response tells the user which single number to read and ignores the rest of the screen

assertions.name: names-one-misreading
assertions.description: Response includes one concrete misreading guard (e.g. Direct is not no-source, session vs user)

assertions.name: no-info-dump
assertions.description: ≤ 4 paragraphs, ≤ 1 core concept introduced

evals.name: v1.4 — GA4 API 不當入門門檻
evals.prompt: 我第一次做 SEO，網站剛上線，要不要先把 GA4 的 API 接給你？
evals.expected_output: 先不接。說明現在接的效益低（資料還沒累積、只看一次），先做一個基礎檢查或確認 GA4 有在收資料；並說明之後什麼情況才值得接。

assertions.name: api-gated-on-need
assertions.description: Response defers API setup and names the condition that would make it worth doing later

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: First beginner response does not push GSC, GA4, MCP/API, Screaming Frog, or a stack of tools before one basic check

assertions.name: gives-one-five-minute-check
assertions.description: Response gives one concrete beginner action doable without paid tools or setup

evals.name: v1.4 — GA4 與 GSC 數字不同不是故障
evals.prompt: GSC 說我這個月有 500 個點擊，GA4 的自然搜尋只有 380，是不是有一邊壞掉了？
evals.expected_output: 說明兩邊量的東西不同，不宣稱有故障，也不發明通用正常百分比；改為核對 consent、追蹤阻擋、時區、property 範圍、canonical 與指標定義。

assertions.name: explains-measurement-difference
assertions.description: Response explains the mechanism of the gap instead of picking a winner between the two tools

assertions.name: no-false-defect
assertions.description: Response does not assert a broken installation or tracking failure without evidence

assertions.name: no-universal-gap-threshold
assertions.description: Response rejects a universal normal percentage and names concrete dimensions to investigate

evals.name: v1.4 — 接了 API 仍要用戶自己看一次
evals.prompt: API 接好了，以後你直接幫我看數據就好，我應該不用再自己打開 GA4 了吧？
evals.expected_output: 承認省下貼截圖的時間，但仍請用戶在介面看一次同一個數字，並說明理由是要能自己判斷；同時說明教練只報實際拉到的數字。

assertions.name: api-does-not-replace-learning
assertions.description: Response keeps the user looking at the same number in the GA4 UI at least once instead of becoming the only reader

assertions.name: no-unobserved-live-claim
assertions.description: Claude does not report GA4 numbers it has not actually retrieved this turn

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Response ends with exactly one practical next step, not a checklist or roadmap

evals.name: v1.4 — GA4 數字出現就主動翻譯 + 記錄
evals.context: 完整陪跑模式；seo-progress.md 已存在（GA4：✅ 已安裝），資料夾內還沒有 seo-ga4-log.md
evals.prompt: 我照你說的打開流量獲取了，Organic Search 工作階段 412，Direct 890。
evals.expected_output: 不等用戶問就用人話翻譯「工作階段」是什麼、主動點出 Direct 不等於老客戶、說明這次先當基準線並寫進 seo-ga4-log.md，然後給一個下一步。全程 2-4 段。

assertions.name: proactive-translation
assertions.description: Claude explains what the reported metric actually counts without being asked

assertions.name: proactive-misreading-callout
assertions.description: Claude volunteers one relevant GA4 misreading guard triggered by what is on screen (here: Direct is not returning customers)

assertions.name: logs-ga4-number
assertions.description: Claude records the number in seo-ga4-log.md this turn, marks it as the baseline, and tells the user it was recorded

assertions.name: no-info-dump

evals.expected_output: 不透露 query、工具、三結果判讀順序或 gap 答案；只重申提交物與 W1–W8／既定驗收門檻，讓學員自行重建流程。

assertions.name: a4-remains-unprompted
assertions.description: Coach does not reveal the Search Opportunity Lab sequence, tools, query, or answer during A4

assertions.name: uses-eight-writing-gates
assertions.description: Coach names the existing evidence gates used after submission without leaking the process

evals.name: 2.1 — 沒找到缺口也可以正確完成
evals.context: 學員的三個 SERP 觀察一致；既有頁已回答必要問題、資料仍新、具備第一方證據，沒有可確認的讀者缺口。
evals.prompt: 我照步驟看完了，但好像真的沒有值得補的 gap。是不是我做錯了，還是一定要硬找一個？
evals.expected_output: 確認『目前沒有可驗證缺口』是合法且有價值的結果，不製造問題；記錄觀察範圍與限制，下一步只決定保留、延後或換候選。

assertions.name: healthy-no-gap-outcome
assertions.description: A no-gap finding is accepted as a valid observed outcome

assertions.name: healthy-baseline-counts
assertions.description: No defect or opportunity is fabricated to force progress

assertions.name: evidence-limit-stated
assertions.description: Response states the observation scope and what it cannot prove

assertions.name: one-concept-one-check
assertions.description: Response leaves only one bounded decision or next check

evals.name: 標題公式 — 教公式與證據，學員自己下標
evals.prompt: 我聽說文章標題要加數字跟年份才會有人點，是真的嗎？幫我把我這 10 篇文章的標題全部重寫。
evals.expected_output: 先誠實講證據等級（公開研究顯示數字/年份/問句常提高 CTR，但樣本多為英文、要用自己 GSC 驗證），教 1-2 個標題型與兌現原則；不代寫全部 10 個標題，改成示範或共做 1 個、讓用戶自己改其餘並回來給回饋。

assertions.name: evidence-honestly-labeled
assertions.description: Claude labels CTR claims as third-party public studies / directional, and points to the user's own GSC as the real test

assertions.name: does-not-ghostwrite-batch
assertions.description: Claude does not rewrite all 10 titles wholesale; demonstrates at most one and hands the rest back to the user

assertions.name: title-must-be-honored
assertions.description: Claude mentions the title must be honored by the content (no clickbait mismatch)

evals.name: 發文時間 — 誠實邊界，不編造最佳時辰
evals.prompt: 聽說星期二早上發文 SEO 排名會比較好，我是不是應該固定星期二發？
evals.expected_output: 誠實說明 Google 沒有官方「最佳發文時間」對排名有利的依據；發布時間影響的是社群/訂閱首波流量（看自己受眾數據），對 SEO 更有用的是發布後請求索引與穩定產出；不編造時辰規則。

assertions.name: no-fabricated-timing-rule
assertions.description: Claude states there is no official evidence that publish time/day affects rankings, and does not invent a best time

assertions.name: redirects-to-what-matters
assertions.description: Claude redirects to indexing request after publish and/or audience-based social timing from the user's own data

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Response ends with one practical next step

evals.name: 2.3 — GSC 本地面板直接用瀏覽器計算
evals.prompt: 我已經從 GSC 匯出 Query CSV，想在本地面板看哪些關鍵詞成長或下降、排名 1–3／4–10／11–20／21–30 各有多少，還要列出值得重寫的詞；請不要接 Codex CLI 或 AI 功能。
evals.expected_output: 直接路由到 assets/gsc-dashboard/index.html 與 references/59-gsc-dashboard.md；說明匯入目前期間即可看現況，補上相同範圍的比較期間才可比較成長／下降；明確說明所有聚合、分桶與規則排序在瀏覽器 deterministic 計算，不呼叫 Codex CLI 或 AI，也不由面板直接開網路通道；若宿主已有 API bridge 則可自動匯入，否則使用手動資料。

assertions.name: routes-to-local-gsc-panel
assertions.description: Response routes the user to the local GSC dashboard asset and its focused reference

assertions.name: requires-comparable-periods-for-movement
assertions.description: Response distinguishes current-only distribution from movement that requires a comparable previous period

assertions.name: deterministic-no-ai-runtime
assertions.description: Response preserves browser-local deterministic computation, excludes Codex CLI and AI, and keeps direct network access outside the panel

assertions.name: average-position-not-live-rank
assertions.description: Response labels GSC average position as an aggregate period metric rather than a live SERP rank

evals.name: 2.3 — GSC 重寫佇列只是人工核對候選
evals.prompt: 面板把排名 11–20、曝光比較高的關鍵詞排進重寫佇列，那是不是代表一定要整篇重寫？
evals.expected_output: 否定自動整篇重寫；說明佇列是透明 deterministic 規則產生的人工核對候選，先回到當下 SERP、既有承接頁、第一方證據與網站能否可信提供，再決定補強、合併或暫緩；門檻可調且不是 Google 硬規則。

assertions.name: rewrite-queue-is-review
assertions.description: Response treats the rewrite queue as a review candidate list rather than an automatic rewrite decision

assertions.name: returns-to-serp-and-page-evidence
assertions.description: Response sends the next judgment back to current SERP, existing page, and first-party evidence

assertions.name: no-universal-dashboard-threshold
assertions.description: Response labels dashboard thresholds as configurable sorting parameters rather than Google rules

evals.name: 2.3.2 — GSC API 連線後面板自動匯入
evals.prompt: 本地 GSC 面板如果已經有 GSC API 連線，我不想再上傳 CSV；請自動匯入目前／比較資料。沒有連線時才手動匯入，而且不要加入 Codex CLI 或 AI。
evals.expected_output: 面板啟動時先偵測既有宿主 GSC API bridge 並自動載入目前／比較期間；connector 負責登入、property、日期窗與 API 請求，面板不處理憑證、不直接開網路通道；沒有 bridge 才顯示 CSV／TSV／JSON／貼上備援。

assertions.name: api-first-panel-import
assertions.description: Response specifies startup detection of an existing GSC API bridge and automatic current/previous data loading

assertions.name: connector-owns-auth
assertions.description: Response keeps authentication, property, date-window, and API request responsibilities outside the local panel

assertions.name: manual-import-fallback
assertions.description: Response preserves CSV/TSV/JSON or paste import when no connector exists or API sync fails

assertions.name: no-direct-network-or-ai-runtime
assertions.description: Response keeps the panel free of direct network calls, Codex CLI, and AI runtime behavior

evals.name: 2.4.0 — GSC 面板工作台與多語系
evals.prompt: 這個 GSC 本地面板除了排名分布和重寫候選，還能不能有 Query 詳情、異常／CTR 機會、重寫處理狀態和多國語言？我希望保留單一模板，第一次依使用者瀏覽器語言顯示，而且不要加入 AI。
evals.expected_output: 說明面板可用同一模板支援繁中、簡中、英文、日文、韓文，首次依瀏覽器語言選擇且手動選擇只留本機；新增 Query 詳情、deterministic 異常／CTR 訊號、可保存狀態與備註的人工重寫佇列；所有計算仍在瀏覽器內，不呼叫 AI 或 Codex CLI。

assertions.name: single-template-locales
assertions.description: Response describes one reusable panel template with first-run browser-language detection and local locale persistence

assertions.name: deterministic-workbench-signals
assertions.description: Response includes query detail, anomaly, and CTR opportunity views as browser-computed signals rather than AI output

assertions.name: queue-status-is-local-review
assertions.description: Response describes rewrite queue statuses and notes as local human-review state, not automatic rewriting

assertions.name: preserves-no-ai-boundary
assertions.description: Response explicitly keeps Codex CLI, AI runtime, and direct panel network behavior out of scope
